trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy. The platinum pops last — finish the story, reach 100% completion, and clean up every activity, collectible, and robbery first. There is no shortcut: it is the reward for doing everything else.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story mission and unlocks automatically as you play — just follow the opening and it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the first chapter. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at the Chapter 1 spot for Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the second chapter. Most side content opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the third chapter. Robbery trophies start opening up in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the fourth chapter. After this, the final mission and the endgame cleanup remain.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the last mission of the game. Keep a manual save before the final mission; there is no mission replay, and the 100% checklist appears after the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish that mission. Play through the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The hardest trophy and the biggest Gamerscore (100G). The in-game 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) appears after the story, but earlier progress counts and nothing on it is missable. Expect around 200 hours for the platinum, most of it on this — collectibles, activities, robberies, and exploration all feed into it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts. Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, and airtime all count. It builds up naturally while you drive and fly; if you want to grind it, chain stunt jumps and long airtime runs.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play all 9 activity types at least once — fishing, racing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to master any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every weapon, every range. Learn each weapon's recoil, aim for the high-score targets, and replay the ones you miss.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Win a drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates and shortcuts, keep the drone low through the gates, and do not crash on the tight turns.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win 20 distinct races across Leonida — street, off-road, and water races all count, but each race only counts once, so you need 20 different ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and beat him at fishing — match his catch by reeling steadily, keeping tension without letting the line snap.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Finish any arcade game to the end — pick the shortest one you like and play it through to the credits.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's mission strand — the last mission in his chain. Work through his missions in order until the strand ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand — the last mission in his chain. Work through his missions in order until the strand ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand — the last mission in his chain. Work through his missions in order until the strand ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Finish 8 stranger mission strands — look for the stranger icons around Leonida and work through each chain to its end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand — the last mission in his chain. Work through his missions in order until the strand ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand — the last mission in his chain. Work through his missions in order until the strand ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. MISSABLE — the only trophy that can be missed: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (Lucia's balcony) and disappears after that chapter. Meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it — follow the trail markers, stay downwind, and take the shot when it presents itself.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find and complete 3 full collectible card sets — cards are scattered around Leonida, so check shops, hidden spots, and quest rewards as you explore.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida — open the app at each spot and tag it. Work through the map region by region so you do not miss any.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Finish 50 challenges — the in-game challenge list tracks your progress, so work through the easiest ones first and let the rest come naturally.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape — use tunnels, alleys, and off-road routes to break line of sight.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner and keep your wanted level the whole time — plan a route between nearby shops and do not let the cops catch you between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and drive 100 different vehicles — every car, bike, boat, and plane you get into counts toward the total. Try everything you see parked or driving by.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus and drop 5 enemies before it ends — find a group, trigger it, and chain the takedowns while the slowdown lasts.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the usual departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhino tanks — get in one or take one on, and survive the encounter. The description points at the tanks, so expect armor and heavy firepower to be involved.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out of a jewelry store without tripping the alarm or being spotted — go in quiet, grab the goods, and leave before security responds.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan your escape route before you go in, and have a fast car waiting.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck, grab the cash, and escape the police — block the truck, take the money, and lose the wanted level.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of Leonida — all 52 areas — so the map is fully revealed. Drive, fly, and sail to the far corners, including the islands and the swamps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — find their turf, rob the operation, and get out before their backup arrives.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description asks for a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact unlock method is still unconfirmed — no guide has published verified steps for this trophy yet, so do not rely on any guessed method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description asks you to smash out of a vehicle showroom. The exact unlock method is still unconfirmed — no guide has published verified steps for this trophy yet, so do not rely on any guessed method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley — knock down pins and finish the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partnership moment — spend time with your partner and build the relationship until this pops. The description is vague, so treat it as a relationship milestone rather than a specific task.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices in the game — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500, so keep making decisions as you play and this will unlock on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second try. The exact unlock method is still unconfirmed — no guide has published verified steps for this trophy yet, so do not rely on any guessed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at witnessing something strange. The exact unlock method is still unconfirmed — no guide has published verified steps for this trophy yet, so do not rely on any guessed method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls someone over. The exact unlock method is still unconfirmed — no guide has published verified steps for this trophy yet, so do not rely on any guessed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — collect marked bills from robberies and run them through your laundering contacts until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida — buy clothes, weapons, cars, and upgrades until the total hits $100,000. Big purchases count fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida — save up and purchase each one. They are also useful for storing the vehicles you discover.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — drive each vehicle, open the app, and register it. Any 10 vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot

verification: Names, descriptions, grades and Gamerscore cross-checked live on planetgta6.com (Exophase / PSNProfiles / TrueAchievements, 18 Nov) and Output Lag. Gamerscore sums to exactly 1,000. 27 visible, 28 hidden. Only missable: Positive Mental Attitude.
